stories.headline: ‘Trying to dominate’: In Cyprus, some fear Israel’s growing influence
stories.description: Israel now reaches into Cyprus’s water, gas, health and defence and many Cypriots fear their island is losing control.

stories.headline: US in ‘denuclearisation’ talks with Russia and China: Trump
stories.description: US and Russia each have more than 4,000 warheads. China set to catch up with them within five years, Trump says.

stories.headline: Action needed to save water, minister tells MPs
stories.description: Severe drought was declared across parts of southern England after months of low rainfall.

stories.headline: ‘It was fake’: Indian villagers allege forgery behind Adani mine project
stories.description: Forged signatures and thumbprints – even of dead and fictitious people – allegedly used to obtain land for bauxite mine.

stories.headline: Poland scrambles fighter jets as Russia strikes western Ukraine
stories.description: Countries along NATO’s eastern flank growing increasingly concerned about the risk of escalation of the war in Ukraine.
